text.en: A child wanted a gift box for Diwali sweets. First she opened an old cardboard box carefully to see what it looks like when flat.

Collect some cardboard boxes and open them up carefully. See the flat shapes inside.
A flat opened box is called a net. It shows the faces of the solid in one flat picture.
Count the faces and notice their shapes.
Make an envelope for a Diwali card. Take a square piece of paper and fold it step by step.
You can also make cylinders and cones from paper, and cubes and cuboids from the nets given at the end of the book.
Trace around the faces of a solid like a matchbox to get its outlines. You will see rectangles and sometimes squares.
Use shape cut-outs to make pictures of houses, boats and animals.

problem.en: Trace the faces of a matchbox. What shapes do you get?

text.en: Press each face on paper and draw around it.

prompt.en: Why do two children get different shapes when they trace?

points.en: A net is a flat opened box.
Trace faces to see their shapes.
Fold paper to make an envelope.
